title: Live-edge table with an epoxy pour
tagline: Flattened with a handheld planer and belt sander, finished in polyurethane, on pin legs
summary: Started by my sister and left for a couple of years, finished during a cleanup. Handheld electric planer and belt sander to flatten, several coats of polyurethane, and pin legs that keep the slab looking like it floats.
